propositions: Under rich_text_cutover='cloud', the differ's local body key escapes markdown-active characters via AdfCodec.normalize_outbound (markdown round trip), while the Jira-side key does not escape (adf_to_text decode), causing markdown comments to never match their own landed bodies.

The send path encodes a decorated body (with HTML comment marker), which causes markdown_to_adf's fallback to degrade the whole document to plain text; the local key rounds-trips the undecorated body through rich mode, producing a wire mismatch.

The local dedup key must be derived by predicting the exact as-sent wire (decorate → fit → encode) and decoding it with the same _normalize_comment_body decoder used on the Jira side, not via codec.normalize_outbound.
A markdown comment within the length limit generates a spurious duplicate mutation because the two sides of the body-equality key differ in escaping and rich-mode behavior.
